Package com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence

Class IntelReportEntity

java.lang.Object
com.wgblackmon.aihealthcare.infrastructure.persistence.IntelReportEntity
@Entity public class IntelReportEntity extends Object
JPA entity representing a row in the intel_reports table.

This is a mutable infrastructure class that mirrors the immutable IntelReport domain record. All mapping between the two types happens inside IntelReportAdapter.
